group.passage: How can a farmer tell whether a field is healthy? One simple way is to grab a shovel. A farmer can dig up a shovelful of topsoil at least 15 centimeters deep and count the earthworms in it. According to a guide made for farmers in the US state of Oregon, more than five worms is a good sign. Finding none at all is a warning that something is wrong with the soil. Earthworms matter because of the work they do. Scientists call them ecosystem engineers, since their eating and digging change the soil around them. Many earthworms feed on dead leaves, and some pull leaves down into their tunnels. The waste they leave behind, called casts, holds more nutrients and helpful bacteria than the soil around it, so it works like a natural fertilizer for plants. Their tunnels are useful too. As earthworms move through the ground, they open paths that let air and rainwater travel deeper into the soil. Plant roots often grow along these old tunnels. In addition, the slime on a worm's body helps stick tiny bits of soil together into crumbs that do not break apart easily. Of course, a count is only useful if it is done at the right time. Water makes up more than 75 percent of an earthworm's body weight, so worms need moist ground and are hard to find when the soil dries out. The guide tells farmers to count toward the end of spring or fall, when the soil is wet but not soaked. Farming methods also make a difference. Plowing breaks up tunnels and buries the dead plants that feed and protect the worms. Fields that are not plowed can hold two to three times as many earthworms as plowed ones.

translation_zh.text:
農民要怎麼知道一塊田健不健康？一個簡單的方法是拿起鏟子。農民可以挖起一鏟至少 15 公分深的表土，數一數裡面有幾條蚯蚓。根據一份為美國奧勒岡州農民編寫的指南，超過五條就是好兆頭；一條都找不到，則是土壤出了問題的警訊。
蚯蚓之所以重要，是因為牠們做的工作。科學家稱牠們為「生態系工程師」，因為牠們吃東西和挖洞會改變周圍的土壤。許多蚯蚓以落葉為食，有些還會把葉子拖進地道裡。牠們排出的糞便叫做糞土，所含的養分和有益細菌比周圍的土壤多，所以就像是給植物的天然肥料。
牠們的地道也很有用。蚯蚓在地底下鑽動時，會開出通道，讓空氣和雨水深入土壤。植物的根常常沿著這些舊地道生長。此外，蚯蚓身上的黏液會把細小的土粒黏成不容易散開的團粒。
當然，數蚯蚓要在對的時間數才有意義。水占蚯蚓體重的百分之 75 以上，所以蚯蚓需要濕潤的土地，土壤一變乾就很難找到牠們。指南建議農民在春末或秋末、土壤濕潤但沒有泡水的時候數。耕作方式也有影響。犁田會破壞地道，並把餵養、保護蚯蚓的枯死植物埋起來。不犁的田裡，蚯蚓的數量可能是犁過的田的兩到三倍。
